content.value: The number of customers arriving at a grocery store can be modelled by the Poisson process. (10) The average customer per hour is 20.
i) Find the probability that there are 5 customers between 9:00 to 9:40 and 20 customers between 11:00 to 11:30.
ii) Find the probability that at least one customer between 9:00 to 9:40.
